get.summary: Gets registrations filtered by status for the authenticated user's organizations

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Registration status filter (Active, Pending, Expired, or All)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Current page number (1-based).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description:
Optional point-in-time reference date. When provided, status filters use this date instead of now,
            and status=All applies a point-in-time window filter. When omitted, the current UTC time is used.

post.summary:
Searches for active registration status of students by national Ids.
Returns whether each national Id has an active student affiliation in any school.
Requires both @gagnagatt/read (class-level) and @gagnagatt/registrations/search scopes.
post.description:
This endpoint does not enforce organization-based access control (no org_ids filtering).
The calling service (Tryggingastofnun / National Insurance Company) has statutory authority
under Icelandic law to query the registration status of any national Id for the purpose of
determining compensation eligibility. Access is controlled exclusively via the
@gagnagatt/registrations/search OAuth2 scope.

requestBody.description: Request containing list of national Ids to check (max 5000)
